end.summary:
Explored the judiciary’s role in making fair decisions.
Practised the court structure: District Court, High Court and Supreme Court.
Explained appeal as taking a decision to a higher court for review.
Distinguished civil disputes from criminal offences and discussed the state’s role in criminal cases.
Teach-back was not yet completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the court hierarchy and used the third-umpire idea to connect fair decisions with judicial review. Vihaan correctly identified examples of criminal cases and explained why the state presents criminal cases, while distinguishing punishment in criminal cases from remedies in civil cases. The full teach-back was not completed, so at home, ask Vihaan to explain one civil case, one criminal case and the path of an appeal in three short steps.
